readings.meaning: video encoding format or file setting

ambiguity: At small list sizes, four blocky letters look like an unreadable black bar or any other text badge (HDMI, HDTV, JPEG).

reasoning: The icon consists solely of the four letters 'HEVC' (High Efficiency Video Coding), which is a technical format setting/property rather than a visual object, and violates the rule against icons that are only letters or digits. At small to-do list sizes, four dense letters become an illegible smudge and fail to provide a glanceable pictorial cue.
